reference_prolog:
% Case facts
posted_delivery_bond.
ice_form_i_352_delivery_bond.
bond_secured_delivery_of_foreign_national.
bonded_foreign_national.
ice_made_written_request_to_produce.
failed_to_produce_bonded_foreign_national.
ice_declared_bond_breached.
appealed_for_reinstatement.
initial_nta_missing_time_or_place.
obligor_claimed_no_court_date_notice.
argued_pereira_invalid_nta.
argued_removal_proceedings_never_commenced.
argued_nta_defect_prejudiced_delivery.

% Negative/absent case facts represented as defined predicates that fail
produced_bonded_foreign_national :- false.
ice_failed_to_make_written_production_request :- false.
government_prevented_compliance_with_production_request :- false.
bond_cancelled_before_production_request :- false.

% Legal framework
delivery_bond_contract :-
    posted_delivery_bond,
    ice_form_i_352_delivery_bond,
    bond_secured_delivery_of_foreign_national.

bond_condition_required_production :-
    delivery_bond_contract,
    bonded_foreign_national,
    ice_made_written_request_to_produce,
    \+ bond_cancelled_before_production_request.

violation_of_bond_condition :-
    bond_condition_required_production,
    failed_to_produce_bonded_foreign_national.

complete_nonproduction :-
    failed_to_produce_bonded_foreign_national,
    \+ produced_bonded_foreign_national.

serious_extent_of_violation :-
    complete_nonproduction.

legally_sufficient_excuse :-
    ice_failed_to_make_written_production_request.

legally_sufficient_excuse :-
    government_prevented_compliance_with_production_request.

% Pereira/NTA arguments do not excuse failure to comply with an ICE delivery-bond production demand.
nta_defect_argument_present :-
    initial_nta_missing_time_or_place,
    argued_pereira_invalid_nta.

nta_defect_not_delivery_bond_excuse :-
    nta_defect_argument_present,
    obligor_claimed_no_court_date_notice,
    argued_removal_proceedings_never_commenced,
    argued_nta_defect_prejudiced_delivery.

substantial_violation :-
    violation_of_bond_condition,
    serious_extent_of_violation,
    \+ legally_sufficient_excuse,
    nta_defect_not_delivery_bond_excuse.

substantial_performance :-
    produced_bonded_foreign_national.

no_substantial_violation :-
    \+ substantial_violation.

reinstatement_warranted :-
    substantial_performance.

reinstatement_warranted :-
    no_substantial_violation.

eligibility_met :-
    posted_delivery_bond,
    appealed_for_reinstatement,
    ice_declared_bond_breached,
    reinstatement_warranted.

decision(Result) :-
    (   eligibility_met
    ->  Result = 'Accepted'
    ;   Result = 'Dismissed'
    ).

main :-
    catch(
        (   decision(Result),
            writeln(Result)
        ),
        error(existence_error(procedure, PI), _),
        handle_undefined(PI)
    ).

handle_undefined(Name/Arity) :-
    (   current_predicate(Name/OtherArity),
        OtherArity \= Arity
    ->  format('Programming error: called ~w/~w, but only ~w/~w is defined.~n',
               [Name, Arity, Name, OtherArity])
    ;   format('Lack of information: predicate ~w/~w is not defined.~n',
               [Name, Arity])
    ).

:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Should this case be accepted or dismissed?
